targetScope: Choose the cheapest next WS2 discriminator for the current residual from protocol-compatible compact failure-response evidence; this contract does not estimate solver efficacy.
primaryQuantities: exact attempt work/node dose by action and stage
stopRule: Stage A may select a route only under the frozen routing rules in the preflight. If automatic compact response does not discriminate, advance only to the bounded compact-diagnostic Stage B. If Stage B remains diffuse or mirrors controls, route none.

instrument.calibrationNote: Automatic compact failure-response is the low-overhead broad instrument; rich capture remains a separate selected microscope.

refreshTriggers: solver revision materially changes the relevant action/stage semantics
current residual population boundary changes materially
compact failure-response semantics or observer instrumentation changes materially

reproducibility.note: The offline reducer and routing envelope are deterministic for the same compact-response inputs and frozen analysis contract; hosted acquisition timing is outside this claim.

targetEnvelope.benchmarkObjective: inform the next WS2 discriminator choice for the current production residual
targetEnvelope.confirmationPopulation: protocol-compatible post-instrumentation compact-response population when available
